blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon— The lakeside town of Taytay, Rizal, recorded another danger-level heat index of 42.94°C on Wednesday morning, according to the local government. “The heat index has reached 42.94°C — DANGER!” the town’s Public Information Office (PIO) said in a social media advisory. The heat index was recorded at 9:08 a.m. READ: Pagasa warns
